required_wording.value_prediction: No value-prediction improvement is demonstrated; a >=5-point improvement is excluded, but meaningful degradation remains possible.
required_wording.form_and_validity: The regression is consistent with the large assertion-form composition shift, but causal attribution is not possible from this post-hoc, model-selected stratum.
required_wording.kill_given_reference_valid: The +21.76-point change in P(kill | reference-valid) is descriptive only: reference validity is affected by treatment, so conditioning on it produces survivor/selection bias. It is not evidence that SFT became better at killing.

withdrawn_statements: 'most of the validity loss comes from the form change' (as a causal claim)
any causal reading of the P(kill | reference-valid) change
the ~296x multiplier described as the sample needed to establish the effect

H5.scope: narrowed: syntactic/structural contract degradation is weakened. Semantic-oracle validity remains unresolved.

H6.scope: narrowed: progressive late-checkpoint degradation after step 100 is weakened. A rapid early SFT-induced capability shift or forgetting (steps 0-100) remains open.

H2.scope: input choice and assertion form moved under imitation; no value-prediction improvement is demonstrated. Causal support requires a Phase 4 arm.

H4.scope: a train-only probe cannot support distribution shift; it can only weaken it (see protocol amendment 2 decision rules).

power.assumption: the true difference equals the observed +3.4346 points and the SE scales as 1/sqrt(independent clusters)

B_lower_bound_at_least_3_points.why_so_large: the point estimate is only 0.4346 points above the +3-point practical threshold

power.correction: the ~296x figure in the Phase 2 receipt is B at 50% power (the point estimate's lower bound just reaching +3). It is NOT the sample increase needed to show a positive effect, which is question A
